verdict.rationale: The evidence documents built-in, pre-mapped controls and support for standard frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS), but nothing shows users creating custom frameworks or custom controls with their own tests and evidence requirements. Custom fields in AI Systems configuration and webhook/ingestion workflows are adjacent features and earn no credit, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones
